question: Which employers need skills in healthcare?
cypher:
MATCH (col:College {name: $college})-[:IN_MARKET]->(r:Region)<-[:IN_MARKET]-(emp:Employer)-[:HIRES_FOR]->(occ:Occupation)-[:REQUIRES_SKILL]->(sk:Skill)<-[:DEVELOPS]-(course:Course {college: $college})
WHERE toLower(sk.name) CONTAINS 'health'
RETURN emp.name AS name, emp.sector AS sector, emp.description AS description,
       emp.website AS website,
       collect(DISTINCT occ.title) AS occupations,
       count(DISTINCT sk) AS matching_skills,
       collect(DISTINCT sk.name) AS skills
ORDER BY matching_skills DESC
interpretation: This query finds all employers in College of the Desert's regional labor market that require health-related skills — such as Public Health, Mental Health, Health Education, or Health Information Systems — and ranks them by how many of those skills align with courses offered at College of the Desert.

question: High-paying occupations in healthcare
cypher:
